title: Series Rate Schedule for Interest Extinguished at a Whole Life Insurance Loan Offset
content:
The annual rate at which interest is extinguished at a loan offset on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy is set by the policy series that the issue date falls in.

- A policy issued **before January 1, 1990** is charged **8% (0.08)**.
- A policy issued **from January 1, 1990 through December 31, 2004** is charged **7% (0.07)**.
- A policy issued **on or after January 1, 2005** is charged its tier's loan interest rate: 8% on the Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life; 6% on the Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100, Paid-Up at 65, 20-Pay and 10-Pay tiers; 5% on the Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life.

The issue date is the one on the whole life policy record.

| Issue date (hypothetical) | Tier | Rate at offset |
|---|---|---|
| June 30, 1987 | Paid-Up at 65 | 8% |
| January 1, 1990 | Paid-Up at 100 | 7% |
| December 31, 2004 | 10-Pay | 7% |
| January 1, 2005 | Single Premium | 5% |
| March 3, 2012 | Final Expense | 8% |
